title: Answer: one abstract function beneath mind and body, stated as free energy minimization

statements.text: Mind and body are two appearances of one underlying thing, and what is fundamental to both is a function stated in abstract terms, ideally mathematics. For consciousness that function is free energy minimization, felt as affect from the inside and seen as brainstem arousal from the outside. The theory takes no position on the fundamental physics beneath it.

sources.quote: Memory is not a stuff; it is a function.
We will argue that the underlying function of consciousness is free energy minimization
